items.text: Its alternative budget proposed no change to the public health insurance that covers everyone who works or lives legally in the country. The only health measure reported in it was replacing medical aid for undocumented migrants with emergency-only care.

Its alternative budget proposed no cut to the existing income support for citizens, in which mandatory pension schemes replace about 70 percent of an average worker's net earnings, unemployment benefits replace about 68 percent of an average earner's net income in the second month out of work, and a single adult with no other income is guaranteed about 36 percent of the median income, housing support included. It proposed raising benefits in line with prices in place of a planned freeze.

items.stance: 115 of its 122 legislators voted for, and none against,

items.text: Published an alternative budget proposing to end non-contributory benefits for foreigners who have not worked full-time for at least five years.

Its leaders presented a plan to lower the retirement age to between 60 and 62, while cutting a pension by 5 percent for each missing quarter of contributions, up to half of it, reducing the pension rights earned while out of work, and adding a second, mandatory pension built from savings for workers aged 52 or under.
